# Fortune

> Fortune delivers breaking business news, Fortune 500 rankings, market analysis, and corporate leadership insights across global markets and industries.

Fortune is a leading business publication covering the world's largest companies, financial markets, technology trends, and economic analysis. The site provides comprehensive rankings of top companies globally and regionally, alongside in-depth reporting on finance, investing, energy, real estate, and corporate trends.

## Key Topics

- Fortune 500
- Fortune Global 500
- Business News
- Market Analysis
- Corporate Leadership
- AI Technology
- Supply Chain
- Geopolitics
- Financial Markets
- Energy Industry
- Company Rankings
- Investing Strategies
- Breaking News
- Market Trends
- Workplace Trends

## Company Rankings & Lists

- [Fortune 500 – The largest companies in the U.S. by revenue](https://fortune.com/ranking/fortune500): 2025 Fortune 500 ranking of largest U.S. companies by revenue with Walmart and Amazon
- [Fortune Global 500 – The largest companies in the world by revenue](https://fortune.com/ranking/global500): Fortune Global 500 ranking of world's 500 largest companies by revenue
- [Fortune 500 Europe – The largest companies in Europe by revenue](https://fortune.com/europe/ranking/fortune500-europe): Fortune 500 Europe ranking of largest European companies including Volkswagen and Shell
- [Fortune Southeast Asia 500 – The largest companies in the region by revenue](https://fortune.com/asia/ranking/southeast-asia-500): Fortune Southeast Asia 500 ranking covering energy, banking, and AI-driven businesses
- [Fortune 500 | Articles, Insights & Updates](https://fortune.com/section/fortune-500): Fortune 500, Global 500, and regional rankings of world's largest companies

## Breaking News & Latest Stories

- [Fortune - Fortune 500 Daily & Breaking Business News](https://fortune.com): Fortune homepage with breaking business news, Fortune 500 rankings, and market analysis
- [Fortune's Latest Business Insights & Breaking Stories](https://fortune.com/section/latest): Latest business news and breaking stories covering technology, politics, and international affairs
- [Latest News & Breaking Stories](https://fortune.com/section/news): Breaking news and top stories on business, politics, markets, technology, and culture

## Global Regional Coverage

- [North America Business News & Analysis](https://fortune.com/section/north-america): North American business news, market moves, and trends including airline industry coverage
- [Latest Europe News & Updates | Breaking Stories Across the Continent](https://fortune.com/section/europe): European business news, politics, economy, and tech industry coverage
- [Asia Business News](https://fortune.com/section/asia): Asia business news covering geopolitics, supply chain, trade, and energy markets
- [Middle East Business News, Finance & Market Trends](https://fortune.com/section/middle-east): Middle East business news, finance, market trends, and geopolitical analysis
- [Global Business News & World Market Updates](https://fortune.com/section/global): Global business news, AI technology, corporate leadership, and market updates

## Finance & Markets

- [Finance News, Market Insights & Economic Trends](https://fortune.com/section/finance): Finance news, market insights, stocks, investing, and economic trends coverage
- [Global Economy News, Market Trends & Trade Analysis](https://fortune.com/section/economy): Global economy news, market trends, trade analysis, and labor market coverage
- [Banking and Finance News](https://fortune.com/section/banking-finance): Banking and finance news covering corporate security, AI finance, and financial institutions
- [Investing News, Strategies & Stock Market Trends](https://fortune.com/section/investing): Investing news, stock market strategies, and wealth inequality analysis

## Industries & Sectors

- [Energy News, Sustainability Trends & Industry Analysis](https://fortune.com/section/energy): Energy industry news, oil prices, sustainability trends, and renewable energy analysis
- [Real Estate News, Housing Market Trends & Investment Insights](https://fortune.com/section/real-estate): Real estate news, housing market trends, mortgage rates, and investment insights

## Personal Finance & Wealth

- [Personal Finance News, Money Management & Wealth Insights](https://fortune.com/section/personal-finance): Personal finance, money management, student loans, and wealth planning insights
